def solve(values):
    lo = min(values)
    hi = max(values)
    answer(lo + (hi - lo) // 2)

def answer(v):
    print(v)

def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    # Ensure we read exactly n numbers (though input may have more, but we ignore)
    # The C++ code reads n numbers, so we take first n
    a = a[:n]
    solve(a)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
